Name: (CSP) Novaphene's Starter Package
Author: Novaphene
Description:
Your grandpa surely had great history with Pelican Town and yet Lewis decided to give you.. 20 parsnip seeds.  (ノಠ益ಠ)ノ彡┻━┻

Anyways..
This would work for all the vanilla maps and any modded maps that [b]replace [/b]any of the vanilla farms (for example / like how the Immersive Farm 2 Remastered replaces the Standard farm, etc..). For entirely custom maps that does not replace any of the vanilla farms and instead [b]adds[/b] [b]a custom [/b]farm type, it's now supported in version 2. 

I've included in the images what kind of starter package's you'll get depending on your chosen map. (For Immersive Farm 2 Remastered, it's under Standard farm).
